text.en: Shoppers consistently praise the store owner Sangita and staff members like Vicky for their warmth, generous guidance, and dedication to the local pet community. Reviewers describe team members who take time to suggest tailored products and patiently welcome energetic puppies during visits.

title.en: Charming neighborhood shop with cozy interior

text.en: Visitors enjoy the curated atmosphere of this West 4th Avenue boutique in Kitsilano, praising its selection of single-ingredient Canadian treats and stylish accessories. While one reviewer noted a cramped layout and slick flooring, most consider it a delightful destination for neighborhood dog walks.

Pet owners note that their dogs eagerly pull them toward the store on daily walks to greet staff and enjoy treats. Reviewers also appreciate the thoughtful product advice provided for young puppies, helping new pet parents choose wholesome chews and supplements suited to developing animals.

q.en: Does Benni & Co. carry Canadian-made pet supplies?

a.en: Yes, the store focuses on local and independent Canadian brands, offering single-ingredient treats and pet accessories.

q.en: Is online ordering and shipping available?

a.en: Yes, the shop offers an online store with shipping across Canada for pet accessories, apparel, and goods.

q.en: Are dogs allowed inside the store?

a.en: Yes, pet dogs are welcomed enthusiastically inside the boutique and often receive treats from staff.

q.en: What types of pet products are stocked?

a.en: The boutique stocks premium treats, chews, supplements, walking gear, dog toys, apparel, and grooming essentials.
